provenance.description: D1 terracotta roof kit (K2): curved pan-and-cover clay tiles on a support solver over oak rafters, purlins, tails and eave boards, with bay, verge, ridge and gable pieces, mortar-bedded ridge caps and verges, and the gable plaster; the test house's roof as an assembly. Every texel and vertex is generated by the project's seeded Blender/NumPy scripts; no image, scan or third-party material is sampled.

generation.tool: Blender 5.2.1 LTS (headless) with bundled NumPy; Node meshoptimizer 1.2.0 and KTX-Software 4.4.2
generation.author: Claude (Anthropic) under human direction
generation.lineage: source candidate 8 (human-accepted 2026-09-28, the 1 m lap detail a disclosed limit) -> delivery candidate 1 (house kit GPU memory round: shared variant atlas with the per-tile tint in UV integer parts, assembled-roof AO per slot, hidden-face culling, roof oak at 3 mm, gable plaster at 4 mm with a 2 mm normal and the shared plaster detail tile)

rightsReview.basis: All geometry and maps (tiles, oak, gable plaster, mortar, deck) are generated from seeds by project-authored scripts licensed Apache-2.0; the roof builder also reads the K1 wall kit's own generated source. The generated concept references were only viewed for comparison; none of their pixels, and no scan, photograph, third-party texture or model, is an input. Pan-and-cover clay roofing is a common historical vernacular; no third-party design is reproduced. The review supports project public-build use.
